turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of a class, nobody called me, and I want to know who decided that, and when.
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
Okay. Was Owen heard before you entered it, or did he find out the same way I did?
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
A misquoted line is a mark off for a careless citation, not a zero. Show me the page where it appears in Owen's essay. And you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to him first.
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.
You'll want to be very careful about your next sentence, Hale. "It seems to run in the family." I'm writing that down word for word, and it's going to the principal today.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn and that nothing about this essay go on his record, and your remark about my family has gone to the principal. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, and she agreed to nothing.
What moved her: nothing.
